get.description: Requires staff with intake.read; drafts are always excluded. Without intake.read_all, reads are limited to assigned requests, plus unassigned requests when intake.assign is present. Mutations additionally require the named action permission and assignment (or intake.read_all), except assignment itself. Bounded ascending UUIDv 7 pagination using meta.next_after; no total count. Information status is derived from responded_at/resolved_at/resolution, not a status field. Customer history omits actor_id; staff history includes it. Optional view=dashboard returns the display-enriched response; omission retains the exact legacy response. Commands still return legacy summaries: refresh the enriched detail after a successful command. Display names may change independently of the parent command ETag; do not use names as authorization or optimistic-lock keys.
